items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment-only execution. Revenue evidence covers one day, 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to any site; site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero performance. AI usage is $901.90 across 4,926 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, with 228 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs are incomplete, budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. Reject new dispatches, spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation using recorded evidence.

The delivery-lead request to route two new implementation requests is rejected on financial-control grounds. Queue readiness or operational output is not evidence of positive contribution margin, acceptable cost-to-learn, or budget capacity. Preserve any technically valid work as deferred backlog until the existing reconciliation and measurement gates clear.

Retain the existing revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation work item only. Preserve the $4.92 provider aggregate as unattributed. Do not treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, output counts, or pilot treatment-versus-control output as financial performance or causal lift.
